items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source, and Adobe I/O Events connector for Commerce, caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. Attackers can execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files, requiring user interaction for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source, and Adobe I/O Events for Commerce, allowing low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields. Successful exploitation can lead to session hijacking or unauthorized actions within the victim's account context.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extension
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Remote Code Execution in Mirasvit Cache Warmer Extension
items.summary: A critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie. This flaw has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, identified within APSB26-49, could lead to arbitrary code execution. This issue has a CVSS score of 8.7.

items.title: Path Traversal leading to Arbitrary File System Write
items.summary: A critical path traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, identified within APSB26-49, could allow for arbitrary file system write. This issue has a CVSS score of 8.7.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.
